newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish steel trader sees net up 11 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Polish steel trader sees net up 11 pct in 1996.

text.p: Polish steel products trader Centrostal SA, which is seeking Warsaw bourse parallel market listing, sees its net profit rising to two million zlotys in 1996, the firm said in its issue prospectus.
It said it expected its net to grow to 2.3 million zlotys in 1997, up from last year's 1.8 million.
It said it saw its sales rising to 103.9 million zlotys this year and 112.8 million in 1997, up from last year's 78.6 million. @
The company, a subsidary of Stalexport, plans an initial public offering of one million shares for December 9-20. It has earlier said the minimum issue price was 4.1 zlotys.
